name: What's the difference between just hiring a tile setter and using a coordinated tile installation service?

mainEntity.name: What's the difference between just hiring a tile setter and using a coordinated tile installation service?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hiring a tile setter typically means you are responsible for managing all other aspects of the project, including material procurement, scheduling, and coordinating with other trades. A coordinated tile installation service, like ours, handles all these details for you. We provide a single point of contact, ensuring a cohesive project flow, professional oversight, and a significantly reduced burden on your part.
acceptedAnswer.description: A tile setter installs tiles; a coordinated service manages the entire project, including materials, scheduling, and other trades, reducing your burden.
